name: Marioo
description: '''Omary Ally Mwanga''', known professionally as '''Marioo''' (born 31 December 1995), is a Tanzanian singer, songwriter, and music producer. He is also the founder and CEO of his own record label, Bad Nation. He is known for songs such as "Tete", "Dunia", and "Nairobi" (featuring Kenyan artist [[Bien-Aimé Baraza|Bien]] of [[Sauti Sol]]), which recorded high streaming numbers across major digital platforms in [[Tanzania]] and [[Kenya]], and was associated with Marioo's increased visibility in the East African music scene.
